nodes.label: ADR-006: Full .claude/ Engineering-Process Scaffolding Despite Solo Scope
nodes.rationale: User explicitly requested full enterprise-scale scaffolding (15 subagents, 20 slash commands, ~15 skills, hooks) after being shown a leaner alternative; dissent recorded that this risks the .claude/ scaffolding becoming the project itself. Kept because it's transferable practice and mechanically cheap to maintain once generated.

nodes.label: Rule 7: Prune Scaffolding That Stops Earning Its Keep
